This is classic government overreach—instead of focusing on personal responsibility, law and order, and holding actual criminals accountable, the ruling elites want to tinker with manufacturers and restrict the freedoms of decent, hard-working people who just want to protect their families and homes. It’s an insult to our traditions and another step toward eroding our constitutional heritage.
